# Entity relationship diagrams (live)

One generated Mermaid `erDiagram` per schema of the shared RDS, from the same live catalog dump as the [DB schema reference](../db-schema-reference.md). Newest migration per owner: Booking **bk-020**, CIS **270**, TripPlanner **tp-017**. The DB Schema Dump workflow regenerates these pages after every DB Migrate apply and every night and opens a root PR when the structure changed, so a new or dropped foreign key shows up as a diff here. ## Machine-readable model

The DB Schema Dump run also writes `erd.json` (schemas, tables, columns with full types, PK, unique keys, FKs, DM-6.1 tags, owner; no row data) as a run artifact, the input of the CIS admin data-model view (AA-894 scope 2).
